mapper.sql: approval_id::text AS approvalId, tenant_id::text AS tenantId, principal_id AS principalId, run_id::text AS runId, invocation_id AS invocationId, operation_id::text AS operationId, tool_id AS toolId, target_resource AS targetResource, approval_scope_hash AS approvalScopeHash, scope_definition AS scopeDefinition, effective_args_hash AS effectiveArgsHash, closure_fingerprint AS closureFingerprint, authz_version AS authzVersion, approver_id AS approverId, approver_scope AS approverScope, decided_at AS decidedAt, expires_at AS expiresAt, approval_state::text AS approvalState, terminal_status AS terminalStatus, cancel_reason AS cancelReason, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cap_approval WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid

INSERT INTO cap_approval (tenant_id, principal_id, tool_id, target_resource, approval_scope_hash, scope_definition, effective_args_hash, closure_fingerprint, authz_version, approver_id, approver_scope, decided_at, expires_at, approval_state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{principalId}, #{toolId}, #{targetResource}, #{approvalScopeHash}, #{scopeDefinition}, #{effectiveArgsHash}, #{closureFingerprint}, #{authzVersion}, #{approverId}, #{approverScope}, #{decidedAt}, #{expiresAt}, 'PENDING', #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) RETURNING approval_id::text

INSERT INTO cap_approval (tenant_id, principal_id, tool_id, target_resource, approval_scope_hash, scope_definition, effective_args_hash, closure_fingerprint, authz_version, approver_scope, expires_at, approval_state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{principalId}, #{toolId}, #{targetResource}, #{approvalScopeHash}, #{scopeDefinition}, #{effectiveArgsHash}, #{closureFingerprint}, #{authzVersion}, #{approverScope}, #{expiresAt}, 'AWAITING_HUMAN', #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) RETURNING approval_id::text
mapper.update: UPDATE cap_approval SET approval_state = 'RESERVED', invocation_id = #{invocationId}, operation_id = #{operationId}::uuid, run_id = COALESCE(run_id, #{runId}::uuid), reserved_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid AND approval_state = 'PENDING' AND expires_at > now() AND effective_args_hash = #{effectiveArgsHash} AND closure_fingerprint = #{closureFingerprint} AND authz_version = #{authzVersion}

UPDATE cap_approval SET approval_state = 'INTENT_SUBMITTED', intent_submitted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND approval_state = 'RESERVED'

UPDATE cap_approval SET updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND approval_state IN ('INTENT_SUBMITTED', 'CONSUMED')

UPDATE cap_approval SET approval_state = 'CONSUMED', terminal_status = #{terminalStatus}, consumed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND approval_state = 'INTENT_SUBMITTED'
UPDATE cap_approval SET updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND approval_state = 'CONSUMED'

UPDATE cap_approval SET approval_state = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancelled_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND approval_id = #{approvalId}::uuid AND invocation_id = #{invocationId} AND approval_state IN ('PENDING', 'RESERVED', 'INTENT_SUBMITTED')
